job.title: Junior GenAI & LLM Application Engineer

LlamaIndex & LangChain: constructed document loaders, recursive text chunkers, and query engines
EnterpriseDocSearch: semantic search and question-answering tool over 200 PDF manuals using pgvector
B.Tech Computer Science, PES University, Bengaluru, 2022–2026, CGPA 8.7/10
